Second Sunday in Ordinary Time August 30 2026 This weekend August 29th 30th the Church celebrates the Twenty second Sunday in Ordinary Time Transitioning almost immediately from words of praise and the establishment of the Papacy in last Sunday's Gospel we are reminded today of the humanity of Peter Before he spoke words that were not his own but revealed to him by the Father Matthew 1617 Now speaking his own words he tries to deny the Cross and is in turn rebuked by the Lord This scriptural witness offers a great example of our understanding of papal infallibility This is the belief that the Pope as steward of the Church through the Office of St Peter is preserved by the Holy Spirit from the possibility of error when he solemnly teaches an official doctrine on faith or morals Many people misunderstand this truth of the Faith and believe it means that the Pope can never make a mistake or ever be wrong on anything Of course if the Holy Father were to change his MLB allegiance and begin supporting the Chicago Cubs over the Chicago White Sox he would be wrong And there d be nothing wrong with that His support of a particular sports team does not fall under papal infallibility This is a part of the beauty of our Faith The gift of infallibility belongs not to the Pope as an individual but to the sacred office instituted by Christ Himself Infallibility preserves the Church from doctrinal error not the Pope from human weakness The Blessed Sacrament Weekday Prayer As our renovations continue into the Fall we've needed to return our Daily Mass Chapel back into its primary use The Parish Conference Room Daily Masses will return to be offered in the main Church During weekdays the Blessed Sacrament is now reserved in our Cry Room just outside of the church and open at all hours as a place for prayer with our Eucharistic Lord Discover Catholicism Thursday Sept 3 at 6:30PM We continue to have a number of questions from those interested in learning more about the Catholic Faith and those interested in becoming Catholic To help answer these questions our Discover Catholicism series begins on Thursday September 3 at 6:30PM in the Parish Conference Room This series is for all those interested in learning more about in joining or simply growing deeper in their knowledge of the Catholic Faith This year we will be using resources from the Credo Series created by the Thomistic Institute as the main text for our series This series utilizes a variety of short videos and a guide book to introduce those participating to the vast treasures of the Catholic Faith We strive to create a no pressure environment where all are welcome to freely explore what the Church teaches and why This weekly gathering is perfect for those returning to the Church exploring the Faith for the first time or are simply curious All are welcome There are informational cards available in the Narthex with details about this program I encourage you to take at least one of these cards with you and personally invite someone to join us Your invitation might be the very moment the Lord uses to touch a heart and change a life Join the Choir this Thursday at 6:30PM St Joseph Catholic Church is seeking new members for our Sacred Music Choir The choir serves the prayer of the church Sacred music is prayer and a necessary integral part of the liturgy Our humble role is to lead and support the congregation in singing We strive to offer music that is holy beautiful and fitting for the liturgy helping the congregation enter more deeply into the mystery of the Mass When the Church sings we share in the worship of heaven joining in the song of the angels If you can follow a simple tune and are willing to learn give it a try No great experience is required only a willing heart and a desire to serve Our first practice is this Thursday at 6:30PM Come sing with us God bless Saturday August 29 400 4:45pm Confession 5:00pm Steve Coulardot Sunday August 30 7:10am
